about.title: Background, education & skills
paragraphs: I'm Kalid Muhumed, a computer engineer and junior fullstack developer. My focus is building modern web applications from the ground up, where thoughtful design and scalable architecture meet smart automation.
As a computer engineer I cover UI and web design through to networking, IoT, sensors, and embedded systems, so I can architect solutions where hardware, cloud services, and web apps work together.

In my projects I connect systems and build automated flows that move data reliably in the background. I work agile from sketch and prototype to production. Always simple for the user and solid under the hood.

privacy.title: Privacy & data handling
privacy.intro: I value your privacy and collect as little data as possible. Here is a clear overview of how I handle the information you share with me.
privacy.collectBody: When you contact me through the form, I collect your name, email address, and message. To protect the form from spam, the Web3Forms service is used.
privacy.useBody: Your details are used only so I can read your request and reply. The information is sent to my email. I never use your details for marketing or newsletters, and I do not share your data with third parties.
privacy.controlBody: You can always ask me to delete your information. If you want me to remove your request and contact details, email kalid.automations@gmail.com and I will delete the message.
